title: Deep Learning Super Resolution for Satellite Cloud Mask Downscaling
abstract: arXiv:2608.24715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A vast amount of optical satellite data is being transmitted to Earth-based servers every day, and more than half of this data is affected by haze or clouds. Additionally, this data suffers from the fundamental trade-off between spatial and temporal resolution, which remains largely unresolved, making the acquisition of continuous high-resolution satellite observations of clouds an ongoing challenge. This work addresses this challenge by proposing two Deep Learning super-resolution methods for the accurate downscaling of SEVIRI cloud mask products, as well as a novel cross-sensor cloud mask dataset called SEVMOD-CM, created by spatially and temporally matching MODIS and SEVIRI satellite observations. The two proposed models are a CNN-based (SpatialCNN) and a GAN-based (SpatialGAN) Neural Network. translated_title: 深度学习超分辨率用于卫星云掩膜降尺度
translated_abstract: 每天有大量光学卫星数据被传输到地球上的服务器，其中超过一半的数据受到雾霾或云层的影响。此外，这些数据还面临空间和时间分辨率之间的基本权衡问题，这一问题在很大程度上仍未解决，使得获取连续高分辨率的卫星云观测成为一个持续挑战。本研究通过提出两种深度学习超分辨率方法来解决这一挑战，用于精确降尺度SEVIRI云掩膜产品，并创建了一个名为SEVMOD-CM的新型跨传感器云掩膜数据集，该数据集通过空间和时间匹配MODIS和SEVIRI卫星观测数据生成。所提出的两种模型分别是基于CNN的（SpatialCNN）和基于GAN的（SpatialGAN）神经网络。在SEVIRI光谱和云掩膜产品上训练后，所提出的方法能够预测对应的MODIS云掩膜，实现4倍的空间分辨率提升。
tldr: 本文提出两种深度学习超分辨率方法（CNN和GAN），并创建跨传感器数据集SEVMOD-CM，成功将SEVIRI云掩膜降尺度至MODIS分辨率，实现4倍空间提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two deep learning super-resolution methods (CNN and GAN) and a novel cross-sensor dataset SEVMOD-CM, successfully downscaling SEVIRI cloud masks to MODIS resolution with a 4x spatial enhancement.
